review_notes: Source-first selection: the introduction identifies early-versus-later CEO tenure earnings overstatement as the central question and H1; discretionary accruals and abnormal discretionary expenses are parallel outcomes. Retained the full-control Table 2 column (1) models for those two outcomes. The monitoring interaction tests are introduced separately as H2 after the source states the primary early-versus-later prediction, so they are excluded from this principal family.

Table 2 column (2) replaces the three-year Early Years indicator with separate first-five-year indicators to justify the cutoff; it is not an additional baseline. Equations (1) and (2) are retained as supporting construction regressions because their fitted residuals are the dependent variables in the selected Table 2 models. They are separately estimated in two-digit SIC industry-year groups with a minimum of ten observations; this is repeated fitting, not fixed effects.

The final-year/horizon tests in Table 4 are separately introduced after H1; long-tenure, reversal, R&D-only, write-off and other sensitivity analyses are excluded. The first-five-year coefficient screen and H2 monitoring interaction tests are also excluded.

The paper reports Huber–White standard errors clustered by firm, but does not name the coefficient estimator used for any retained application. OLS is not inferred from the equations or residual construction.

Per-fit N is exact for the reported Table 2 regressions and is copied from their observation rows. The individual Equation (1) and (2) industry-year fits have varying N; only the minimum of ten observations per group is reported, so sample_size is null for each repeated construction equation.

Equation (4) is transcribed as printed: b0 through b9 followed by a10 and a11. The supplied reading and source PDF agree; the mixed coefficient labels are not a missing-equation issue and do not imply cross-equation restrictions. Lagged NOA's sales deflator period remains unspecified.
results_review_notes: The two selected Table 2 column (1) regressions and all reported control coefficients/intercepts are included. Column (2) per-year tenure specifications and later robustness/subgroup regressions are excluded.
Table 1 descriptives cover all variables in the retained column (1) models; its Final Year row was omitted because that term is included only in the excluded column (2).

Table 1 reports Number of observations once per model panel, not a variable-specific N. That panel count is retained in the group sample description and not repeated as an n statistic for each variable.
